item.title: Man dies days after being caught Big Cottonwood Canyon avalanche
item.description: Officials confirm one skier who was critically injured after a Big Cottonwood Canyon avalanche has died. The other 48-year-old skier was released from the hospital.

item.title: St. George Regional Hospital displays medical artifacts from the 1860s
item.description: St. George Regional Hospital has unveiled a collection of historical medical artifacts in its lobby, including items dating back to the first doctors to practice in St. George in the 1860s.

item.title: After losing brother, son in avalanche, O'Keefe family asks for donations for backcountry rescuers
item.description: Brian O'Keefe, known to some friends as Keith, died Sunday in the mountains above Midway, Utah. His family chose to honor his memory by giving back to the volunteers who rushed to find him.
